title: 4/23 end-of-day clean exit relaunched by Restart=always in a loop (NRestarts 0 to 7 in 25 min)
tier_reason: liveness: a clean-exit restart loop of the production scheduler; the past-wake no-op that re-opens this loop is still in deployed code (residual reaches production)

contract.text: After IDLE_END_OF_DAY the scheduler stays alive and sleeps until the next day's wake-up; process exits and clean restarts happen only at day boundaries.
contract.source: ARCHITECTURE.md at 4bd8193 'Daily lifecycle'; commit ddee3db message body

mechanism.text: run_day wrote the IDLE_END_OF_DAY heartbeat and returned, so the process exited; systemd Restart=always (RestartSec=30 since Phase B) relaunched it, the new run_day short-circuited every post-lock branch and reached IDLE_END_OF_DAY again in about 3 min

residual.text: ddee3db's _idle_until_next_wakeup no-ops on a None/malformed/past next_wakeup, and the lookahead wake computed by compute_wakeup_time was a past timestamp (864d3aa body), so the exit/relaunch cycle could continue until 864d3aa (5/09, E49/I-049); later variants: no-games days (736ea8f, 6/09) and eve-of-break (9551818, 7/12, E75/I-075).
residual.source: commit 864d3aa message body; src/bts/scheduler.py compute_wakeup_time at ddee3db; 736ea8f; 9551818

residual.text: At HEAD the no-op on an unset/malformed/tz-naive/past next_wakeup still returns (now with a loud WARNING) and lets systemd relaunch, by design ('bounded restart churn'), relying on restart_spike and check_heartbeat to notice.

watchdog.trigger: three or more clean scheduler exits/relaunches within 60 minutes outside a date transition (one planned idle -> exit -> restart per date), from journal lifecycle lines or NRestarts deltas
watchdog.recovery_assertion: after day completion the heartbeat shows SLEEPING with sleeping_until equal to the next day's wake-up and NRestarts is unchanged until that wake

evidence.what: observed live 4/23 post-games: NRestarts grew from 0 to 7 in 25 min after both picks' games ended; clean process exits relaunched by Restart=always, not watchdog kills
deploy-branch push of head ddee3db created 2026-04-23T22:59:15Z (18:59:15 ET), conclusion success; log unavailable_expired
deploy of 684c160 at 2026-04-23T14:24:40Z restarted the scheduler, the NRestarts=0 baseline in ev1

evidence.locator: commit 864d3aa message body; src/bts/scheduler.py compute_wakeup_time and run_day step 7 at ddee3db
evidence.what: the next-day wake was computed from datetime.now(ET) at the default hour, i.e. today's 10:00 ET, not a future time; the body says tomorrow-lookahead wake-ups were not future timestamps before 864d3aa
the no-op still returns on a past/None wake 'LOUDLY'; the 7/12 eve-of-break incident rode this path

notes: my code reading (ev4): because the lookahead wake was already in the past at day completion, ddee3db's idle sleep likely never engaged; days completing before 20:00 ET (the UTC date rollover used by `bts schedule`, Fable-5 audit P1) would loop until 20:00, later days would restart once - not observed directly; see I-049
the slow form of this loop (RestartSec=300) was part of the pre-Phase-B design ('restart picks up the next day via datetime.now(UTC)'); RestartSec=30 made it fast
verified_recovered unknown: no evidence the fix held; I-049's 5/09 canary failure suggests it did not
the fix's tests (TestIdleUntilNextWakeup) only cover the no-op paths; none asserts a future wake at day completion
